interactions.title: Independent subsea architecture and maintenance review

utterances.verbatim_text: For a diver-sized target in a benign shallow-water environment, our current classification range is about eight hundred metres.
utterances.normalized_text: Management states an 800 m diver classification range in benign shallow water.

utterances.verbatim_text: The farm is about twelve hectares. We are planning around four nodes because one unit does not look sufficient for all pens.
utterances.normalized_text: The pilot operator describes a 12 ha site and expects four nodes.

utterances.verbatim_text: We have not run a controlled intrusion yet, so I cannot say the alerts are validated. The team is coming back to walk us through the traces.
utterances.normalized_text: The pilot has not conducted a controlled intrusion and cannot validate alerts.

utterances.verbatim_text: The maintenance assumption is the fragile part. A fish farm has divers in the water already; a cable route or port generally does not.
utterances.normalized_text: The expert warns that pilot-site maintenance conditions do not generalize to ports or cable routes.

utterances.verbatim_text: Most large buyers prefer an integrated system from a prime because they do not want to carry interface and liability risk.
utterances.normalized_text: The expert says large buyers often prefer integrated prime-contractor systems.

utterances.verbatim_text: A credible public-security procurement path is usually eighteen to thirty months, even when the operational sponsor is enthusiastic.
utterances.normalized_text: The procurement expert estimates an 18-30 month public-security sales cycle.

utterances.verbatim_text: We do not issue a term sheet merely to preserve optionality. The controlled sea trial must be the gate.
utterances.normalized_text: The fund lens requires controlled technical evidence before an external term-sheet act.

discrepancy_rules.label: Difficult-target range values are materially incompatible
discrepancy_rules.reason: The compiler proposes a discrepancy; a professional must determine whether the values truly share the same operating envelope.
hypothesis_templates: The nominal range may refer to controlled detection or classification rather than reliable customer-scale coverage.
The customer may be planning overlap, redundancy or a different target class.
Environmental noise, geometry or incomplete power configuration may reduce the effective range.

discrepancy_rules.label: Pilot alert validation is represented as both true and false
discrepancy_rules.reason: The company deck and customer reference describe incompatible validation states.
hypothesis_templates: The company may use 'live' to mean data streaming rather than validated intrusion alerts.
The deck may describe a later configuration than the customer has received.

discrepancy_rules.label: A load-bearing position is invalid under its explicit condition

agent_missions.label: Map public-security procurement path
agent_missions.objective: Identify credible buyer, prime-contractor, budget and contracting routes for the first paid production deployment.
prohibited_sources: Confidential company names in external queries
agent_missions.data_egress_policy: No confidential deal text leaves PANTA
agent_missions.expected_output: New public source pack with claim proposals
agent_missions.stop_condition: Two independent public routes or explicit no-evidence result

agent_missions.label: Build independent maintenance cost range
agent_missions.objective: Estimate maintenance logistics and cost for ports and cable routes without resident divers.
prohibited_sources: Contacting customer or expert without authority
agent_missions.expected_output: Cost range and operating assumptions as proposed claims
agent_missions.stop_condition: Three independent sources or explicit coverage limit

agent_missions.label: Run controlled multi-target sea trial
agent_missions.objective: Measure detection and classification range, false positives and response integration across declared target classes.
agent_missions.expected_output: Controlled test report and instrumented raw data
agent_missions.stop_condition: Pre-registered protocol completed or test declared invalid

agent_missions.label: Prepare export-control classification request
agent_missions.objective: Determine classification, buyer-country restrictions and security accreditation path.
prohibited_sources: Filing or instructing counsel without authority

agent_missions.label: Recompute delayed-milestone financing path

allowed_sources: Admitted cash, burn, round and milestone inputs
agent_missions.stop_condition: Scenario validates and is professionally reviewed
